content_sections.text: The University of Calicut issued this notification from its administrative office at Calicut University P.O., in Kerala. faq.question: Q1. Why has the University of Calicut advertised this post again?
faq.answer: No candidates came to the interview held on 3 September 2026 under the earlier Notification No. 193539/AD-A-ASST-2/2022/Admn dated 27.01.2026, so the post has been advertised again.

faq.question: Q2. Where will the Technician (Music) work?
faq.answer: At the School of Drama & Fine Arts, Dr. John Matthai Centre, Aranattukara, Thrissur.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply with a diploma instead of a degree?
faq.answer: Yes. A Diploma Holder of Music Academy, or someone with an equivalent qualification from an Institute recognized by the University of Calicut, is eligible, as is a graduate in Music.

faq.question: Q4. Is theatre experience required?
faq.answer: No. A record of taking part in theatrical activities and experience in orchestration are desirable, not essential.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit, and is there any relaxation?
faq.answer: The limit is 40 years as on 01.01.2026. SC, ST and OBC candidates get the usual relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. How much does the post pay?
Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: By an interview, which the university's Recruitment Section will arrange after it receives the online applications.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the appointment is on a contract basis.
